meaning:
σειρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: Jdg.16:13-14, 19 (מַחְלָפָה), Pro.5:22 (חֶבֶל) * ;]
1. (a) a cord;
(b) a chain (cf. Pr., l.with): σειραὶ ζόφου, 2Pe.2:4, Rec., R, mg. (see: σειρός).
2. a lock of hair (Jg, ll. with).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
